title: Site Initiation & Kit Inventory Coordinator Entry
description:
Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data\-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.

  

Labcorp is seeking a Site Initiation \& Kit Inventory Coordinator Entry to join our team at Yeshwantpur, Bangalore, Karnataka.

Rotational Shift


AM : 05:30 AM – 02:30PM


PM : 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM

title: Platform Engineer - SAP Basis
description:
Location: Bangalore, Karnātaka, India
Category: Information Technology
Job ID: R61483
widget: Full time
Brand: PVH
Non\-Retail
  
**About Us:**


We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best\-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH\+.

  



One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. Our collective desire is to create a workplace environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard, and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. Learn more about Inclusion \& Diversity at PVH **here**.

  

  

**Job Description**


**Key Responsibilities:**


* **SAP Landscape \& Platform Administration:** Lead administration, monitoring, maintenance, and technical governance of complex SAP landscapes including **S/4HANA, BW/4HANA, SAP CAR, SLT and associated SAP HANA systems** across production and non\-production environments.
* **RISE with SAP Operations:** Manage SAP systems hosted under **RISE with SAP**, coordinating closely with SAP Enterprise Cloud Services and internal teams for incidents, service requests, maintenance activities, infrastructure changes, upgrades, backups, restores, certificates, connectivity and operational issues.
* **S/4HANA \& HANA Technical Operations:** Own Basis activities for S/4HANA environments including system health monitoring, HANA administration, performance analysis, parameter management, transports, client administration, job management, kernel updates and technical troubleshooting.
* **BW/4HANA \& CAR Support:** Provide Basis and platform support for **BW/4HANA and SAP CAR** landscapes, including system performance, interfaces, batch processing, HANA resource utilization, availability, connectivity and integration dependencies.
* **SAP SLT Administration:** Manage and troubleshoot **SAP Landscape Transformation Replication Server (SLT)** configurations, RFC connectivity, replication health, latency, table replication issues and integrations between SAP source systems and HANA/BW platforms.
* **SAP BTP Administration \& Integration:** Support **SAP BTP** environments including subaccounts, entitlements, destinations, connectivity, Cloud Connector, certificates, trust configuration, identity integration and connectivity between BTP and on\-premise/RISE SAP applications.
* **System Upgrades, Patching \& Lifecycle Management:** Plan and execute SAP technical upgrades, SPS/FPS updates, kernel upgrades, HANA revisions, support\-pack activities and maintenance cycles while coordinating downtime, testing, validation and rollback strategies.
* **Transport \& Change Management:** Govern SAP transport processes across development, quality and production landscapes, ensuring proper approvals, segregation of duties, traceability and adherence to enterprise change\-management controls.
* **Performance \& Availability Management:** Proactively monitor SAP application and HANA database performance, identify bottlenecks, perform root\-cause analysis and drive optimization for memory, CPU, expensive SQL, background jobs, interfaces and application workloads.
* **Security, Compliance \& Audit Readiness:** Maintain strong SAP technical controls aligned with corporate security and compliance requirements, including **user administration controls, privileged access, password policies, RFC security, system parameters, audit logging, transport controls and segregation of duties**.
* **Audit \& Evidence Management:** Act as a key Basis SME for **internal audits, external audits, SOX/ITGC reviews and compliance assessments**, providing system\-generated evidence, control documentation, change records, access reviews, configuration details and remediation responses.
* **SOX / ITGC Control Execution:** Support and periodically validate controls covering **logical access, privileged access, change management, system operations, backup/restore, batch jobs, interface monitoring and production access**, ensuring identified gaps are remediated within agreed timelines.
* **Disaster Recovery \& Business Continuity:** Participate in DR strategy, system recovery planning and periodic DR exercises for critical SAP environments, validating backup integrity, recovery procedures, dependencies, RTO/RPO objectives and documenting test outcomes.
* **Incident \& Problem Management:** Lead resolution of high\-priority SAP technical incidents, perform detailed RCA, coordinate across SAP, infrastructure, network, security, application and vendor teams, and implement preventive corrective actions.
* **Technical Architecture \& Governance:** Provide technical recommendations for SAP landscape design, sizing, scalability, high availability, interfaces, cloud connectivity and lifecycle strategy while ensuring alignment with SAP best practices and enterprise architecture standards.
* **Vendor \& SAP Coordination:** Serve as the technical focal point for **SAP RISE/ECS, SAP Product Support and third\-party vendors**, managing escalations, service requests, problem investigations and implementation of SAP recommendations.
* **Automation \& Operational Excellence:** Identify opportunities to automate Basis operational activities such as monitoring, health checks, reporting, certificate tracking, job monitoring, audit evidence collection and repetitive administration tasks.
* **Documentation \& Knowledge Management:** Maintain technical architecture diagrams, SOPs, operational runbooks, DR documentation, system inventories, maintenance procedures, audit\-control documentation and troubleshooting knowledge bases.
* **Technical Leadership:** Mentor junior Basis administrators, establish operational standards, conduct technical reviews and provide senior\-level guidance during upgrades, migrations, outages, audits and major SAP transformation initiatives.

**Qualifications:**


* 10\+ years of hands\-on experience in SAP and SAAS services
* Extensive experience in Managing and working with Managed services
* Experience with cloud platforms like AWS will be a plus
* Experience managing the implementation, enhancement, upgrade, and support of large ERP applications in a fast\-paced, rapidly changing environment
* Experience in leading through a transition to modern ERP platforms
* Strong troubleshooting skills, with a proactive approach to problem\-solving and system optimization
* Strong understanding of automation, auditability, and availability in cloud environments and on\-premises solutions
* Communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and drive change across global teams
* Project Management skills are a plus

*PVH Corp. or its subsidiary ("PVH") is an equal opportunity employer and considers all applicants for employment on the basis of their individual capabilities and qualifications without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sex, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, sexual orientation, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military status or any other characteristic protected under federal, state or local law. In addition to complying with all applicable laws, PVH is also committed to ensuring that all current and future PVH associates are compensated solely on job\-related factors such as skill, ability, educational background, work quality, experience and potential.*

title: Senior Product Support Engineer
description:
**Senior Product Support Engineer**
Development \+ Technical Support**Experience:** 5–7 years**Function:** Product Engineering / Customer Success**Employment type:** Full\-time**Location:** \[Bangalore / Hybrid / Remote]**Reports to:** \[Manager, Technical Support / Head of Engineering]**About the role**
==================


This is a hybrid engineering and support role for someone who is equally comfortable debugging a customer’s production issue and writing the code that stops it happening again.
You will be the senior technical escalation point for our product across heterogeneous customer environments Windows, Linux and Solaris, integrated with enterprise Active Directory, SIEM platforms and a range of network infrastructure. Roughly half your time will be spent on deep troubleshooting and customer\-facing escalation; the other half on building fixes, tooling, integrations and automation that reduce future ticket volume.
We are looking for someone who treats a recurring support ticket as a defect to be engineered away, not a queue to be worked through.**What you will do**
====================

**Troubleshooting and escalation**
----------------------------------

* Own Level 3 escalations end to endreproduce, diagnose root cause, and drive to resolution across OS, network, database and application layers
* Analyse logs, packet captures, stack traces, core dumps and performance counters to isolate faults in complex multi\-vendor environments
* Diagnose issues spanning customer infrastructure boundaries: authentication, directory services, firewalls, proxies, certificates and network policy
* Work directly with customer IT, security and infrastructure teams, including during high\-severity incidents
* Produce clear root cause analysis documents for customer and internal audiences

**Development**
---------------

* Build and ship fixes, patches and product improvements in C\# and Python
* Develop diagnostic tooling, log analysers, health\-check scripts and automated reproduction harnesses
* Write and optimise SQL for investigation, data correction and performance analysis
* Build and maintain customer\-facing integrationsActive Directory, SIEM connectors, APIs and data pipelines
* Contribute to product hardening: instrumentation, logging quality, error handling and observability

**Deployment and integration**
------------------------------

* Support installation, upgrade and configuration of the product across Windows Server, Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and Solaris
* Configure and troubleshoot Active Directory / LDAP integration, Kerberos, SSO and certificate\-based authentication
* Integrate product telemetry and event data with customer SIEM platforms
* Support cloud and hybrid deployments, including containerised environments

**Knowledge and enablement**
----------------------------

* Maintain runbooks, knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides
* Mentor junior support engineers and act as a technical reviewer on complex tickets
* Feed recurring issues and field insight back into the product roadmap

**Required skills and experience**
==================================

**Experience**
--------------

* 5–7 years in a combined engineering and technical support capacity, supporting an enterprise software product deployed in customer environments
* Demonstrable history of resolving complex, cross\-system production issues

**Operating systems**
---------------------

* Strong administration and troubleshooting on Linux (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu) systemd, journald, permissions, process and resource analysis, package management
* Windows Server administration — services, Event Viewer, registry, PowerShell, IIS, performance monitoring
* Working knowledge of Solaris or another commercial UNIX in a legacy enterprise context
* Shell scripting (Bash, PowerShell)

**Identity and security**
-------------------------

* Hands\-on Active Directory integration: LDAP/LDAPS, Kerberos, group policy, service accounts, delegation, trusts
* Experience integrating applications with SIEM platforms (Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, Microsoft Sentinel or equivalent) — log forwarding, syslog, CEF/LEEF, event normalisation
* Practical understanding of TLS/PKI, certificate management and common certificate failure modes

**Networking**
--------------

* Solid grounding in TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, NAT, firewalls, load balancers and proxies
* Ability to read and interpret packet captures (Wireshark, tcpdump) to isolate connectivity and latency issues

**Development**
---------------

* Proficient in C\# / .NET
* Proficient in Python for automation, tooling and data processing
* Comfortable with Git, code review and CI/CD pipelines
* Ability to read unfamiliar production code and trace a fault to its source

**Database**
------------

* Strong SQL against at least one of SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL
* Query performance analysis, indexing, execution plans, backup/restore, and basic administration

**Cloud**
---------

* Working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) — compute, networking, identity, storage and managed database services
* Familiarity with containerised deployment (Docker; Kubernetes an advantage)
* Understanding of hybrid architectures where product components span on\-premises and cloud

**Desirable**
=============

* Experience with email infrastructure and protocolsIMAP, SMTP, Exchange/EWS, Microsoft Graph
* Exposure to machine learning or classification systems in a production support context
* Infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) and observability tooling (Grafana, ELK, Prometheus)
* Certifications: RHCE/RHCSA, Microsoft (Azure Administrator, Identity and Access Administrator), AWS Solutions Architect, CCNA, Security\+
* Experience supporting regulated customers — financial services, healthcare or public sector
* Familiarity with ITIL incident, problem and change management

**What we look for beyond the checklist**
=========================================

* **Structured diagnostic thinking.** You form hypotheses and test them rather than changing settings until something works.
* **Comfort with ambiguity.** Enterprise environments are undocumented and inconsistent; you find your own way in.
* **Customer\-grade communication.** You can explain a Kerberos delegation failure to a CISO and to a junior admin, correctly, in the same afternoon.
* **Composure under pressure.** You are calm and credible on a Severity 1 bridge call.
* **A bias toward permanent fixes.** You are more interested in the third occurrence never happening than in closing the ticket quickly.

In this P3 professional role, you will operate as a skilled, independent worker and effective mentor, solving complex problems and offering new perspectives on existing solutions.

**Responsibilities:**


In this role, you will take ownership of end\-to\-end database infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments that support Disney's creative, customer\-focused, and service\-minded experiences worldwide. You will act as a proficient problem\-solver and resource for colleagues with less experience, working independently with minimal guidance while occasionally leading small, low\-risk initiatives that enhance system performance, resiliency, and availability. This role matters because robust database platforms are essential to delivering seamless, innovative guest and cast experiences, and success requires a skilled, detail\-oriented, team\-oriented administrator with strong communication and mentoring capabilities.

* Build, deploy, and ensure 24/7/365 availability of database infrastructure supporting Disney Experiences technology solutions.

* Analyze, design, and deploy fault\-tolerant, distributed, and highly available database architectures for high\-volume, high\-availability systems.
* Perform database performance tuning, troubleshooting, and administration, including proactive identification of issues and design of creative remediation solutions.
* Plan and implement infrastructure changes through capacity forecasting, resource utilization analysis, software release cycles, and right\-sizing activities.
* Implement and manage database availability monitoring, metrics, and alerting using tools such as Percona Monitoring and Management, Oracle Enterprise Manager, and cloud provider monitoring solutions.
* Develop and maintain robust backup, restore, and recovery strategies, including disaster recovery planning and execution.
* Leverage automation, Infrastructure as Code, and configuration management tooling to increase operational efficiency while ensuring system reliability and security.
* Prepare and maintain thorough technical documentation, standards, and procedures for database engineering and administration activities.
* Collaborate with internal technology teams and external partners to achieve efficient, cost\-effective database implementations and serve as a technical resource on complex projects such as upgrades or migrations.
* Participate in on\-call rotations and live event support, managing multiple competing priorities in a fast\-paced, deadline\-oriented environment.
* Provide oversight and direction to junior team members, acting as a mentor and go\-to resource for database\-related issues.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Years Of Experience: 5\+ years of relevant professional experience in database administration or closely related technical roles.
* Skilled Sr Database Administrator with minimum 5 years of experience in database administration or related work, operating as an independent worker and effective problem\-solver.
* Proficiency with relational and NoSQL databases, including hands\-on experience managing Amazon RDS or similar cloud database\-as\-a\-service deployments.
* Strong experience with Oracle and/or PostgreSQL, including database internals, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and administration.
* Experience running, deploying, and maintaining production systems in AWS, with a focus on high availability and resiliency.

* Experience with database availability monitoring and status reporting using tools such as Percona Monitoring and Management, Oracle Enterprise Manager, and/or cloud\-native monitoring solutions.
* Well\-versed in database backup, restore, recovery strategies, and disaster recovery planning and implementation.
